t: Document ezorg-email-website as multi-AI case study and add model identity tracking to session track schema
description: ezorg-email-website used 5 AI models across 35 sessions �� a real multi-AI case study. Track schema should capture model identity per turn for performance evaluation.
perceive: 1. Check /home/mario/projects/ezorg-email-website/WAI-Spoke/sessions/ — count sessions, check track files for model diversity. 2. Read templates/commands/wai-track-generate.md — current track point schema. 3. Read WAI-State.json model_log — existing model tracking.
execute: 1. Add 'model' field to track point schema in wai-track-generate.md: model name recorded per turn (e.g., 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). 2. This subsumes the model_log pattern — track data now captures model per turn. 3. Write case study section for framework docs: multi-AI spoke with session count, model diversity, lessons learned. 4. Sync track schema changes to all targets.
verify: 1. wai-track-generate.md schema includes 'model' field. 2. New track entries include model identity. 3. Case study document exists in framework/docs/.
acceptance_criteria: wai-track-generate.md schema includes 'model' as a documented field per track point
New track entries capture model identity per turn
